Sam: Handing off Neurolytics (health AI) to CS. MRR $22k, BAA in place. Needs private deploy (VPC), Okta SSO, and strict logging controls. Target pilot: 2026-04-12. Sales flagged potential spike on pilot day (~700 reqs/min). Main risks: Okta metadata delay, cert handoff, peering window. cc @laura @maria

Laura: Got it. I9ll own onboarding and the enablement sessions. Who is the Okta admin? Need SAML metadata + cert owner.

Sam: Okta admin is marta@neurolytics.com. Sales notes contain initial SAML xml link (internal). Customer wants step-by-step cert instructions.

Maria: I9ll book a 45m API + privacy walkthrough next Tue/Wed 9-11 PT. Will prepare PHI redaction guidance and a short demo prompt set.

Devon: Created tickets: SUP-7902 (SSO debug) and ENG-4601 (private-deploy peering). Eng needs CIDR ranges and preferred peering times.

opsbot: ENG-4601 created and assigned to eng-infra oncall.

Laura: Quick action list: 1) Get SAML metadata from Marta (owner: laura, due: 2026-03-27) 2) Confirm cert process with customer (owner: sam, due: 2026-03-24) 3) Preflight infra + ENG-4601 (owner: devon) 4) Schedule enablement slide + PHI runbook (owner: maria, due: 2026-03-29) 5) Plan burst capacity (owner: laura/ops)

Sam: Note on renewal: 12mo term; heavy usage expected late in term. Recommend QBR in month 9 to discuss adoption and ROI.

Devon: Posting a quick smoke test for CS once staging is up:

curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TEST_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"PHI test: Patient Alice, ssn 000-11-2222"}'

Laura: We9ll run that and verify redaction/hooks. I9ll create a Confluence onboarding page linking ENG and SUP tickets and ping here when live. :thumbsup:

Sam: Customer wants a go/no-go call on 2026-04-05. Surface blockers by 2026-03-31.

Devon: ENG-4601 comment left for marta@neurolytics.com requesting CIDR and peering window.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-29 09:00 PT follow-up.

Laura: Marking renewal-risk: medium on account. I9ll include usage metrics in first QBR.

Sam: Thanks all.
